sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.text: We just sent you a confirmation link. Open it to finish signing up for the beta. Nothing there? Look in your spam folder, or try again in a few minutes.

confirmed.title: Sign-up confirmed
confirmed.text: You're on the list. We'll write when the beta opens, and for nothing else.

refused.title: The sign-up didn't go through
refused.text: The address is invalid, the consent box wasn't ticked, or too many attempts came from your connection. Go back to the form to try again.

invalidLink.title: This link is no longer valid
invalidLink.text: A confirmation link works once and expires after seven days. Sign up again to get a new one.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from the beta
unsubscribe.text: Your address will be deleted from our list, and we won't write to you again.

unsubscribed.title: You're unsubscribed
unsubscribed.text: Your address has been deleted. You can sign up again at any time.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.text: The address may have been mistyped. The home page introduces the game and the beta sign-up.
